description: This file contains classes and functions related to user-defined functions (UDFs) in PySpark, including UDF creation, registration, and wrapping mechanisms.

classes.name: UserDefinedFunction
classes.description: Represents a user-defined function (UDF) in PySpark, with methods for creation, wrapping, and configuration.

classes.name: UDFRegistration
classes.description: Handles registration of UDFs and Java functions within a Spark session.

methods.name: _create_py_udf
methods.description: Creates a Python UDF, determining whether to use Arrow optimization based on session configuration and type hints.

methods.name: _create_udf
methods.description: Constructs a UserDefinedFunction object with specified evaluation type and other parameters.

methods.name: UserDefinedFunction.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a UserDefinedFunction with validation of input types and attributes.

methods.name: UserDefinedFunction.returnType
methods.description: Property that returns the DataType of the UDF, parsing from string if necessary.

methods.name: UserDefinedFunction._build_common_inline_user_defined_function
methods.description: Builds a common inline representation of the UDF with provided arguments.

methods.name: UserDefinedFunction.__call__
methods.description: Allows the UDF object to be called as a function with arguments.

methods.name: UserDefinedFunction._wrapped
methods.description: Wraps the UDF with a function that preserves metadata and attaches docstrings.

methods.name: UDFRegistration.register
methods.description: Registers a UDF with the Spark session, validating eval types and handling both Python functions and existing UDF objects.

methods.name: UDFRegistration.registerJavaFunction
methods.description: Registers a Java function as a UDF.

methods.name: UDFRegistration.registerJavaUDAF
methods.description: Registers a Java UDAF (User Defined Aggregate Function).
